release_notes: Expanded the arena from 17×17 to 30×28 with faster movement, longer build reach, and a less crowded physical workshop.
Added persisted trampoline aim and tilt. R aims; Q or the mouse wheel adjusts angle. Pads show their angle and a live trajectory preview.
Removed the emitter exclusion and added a visible placeable drop zone beneath the pipe.
Rebuilt the starter layout as C→E→G→goal. It scored successfully across a 100-seed reliability sweep.
Legacy saves migrate to the playable angled layout while retaining schema compatibility.

`npm test` passes all orchestrator, game-logic, and 3D scene tests. The web export builds successfully. Browser smoke serving was blocked only by the sandbox’s localhost `EPERM` restriction; deployment remains with the supervisor.
